Recently visited Sundaram Mercedes Benz for one of my friends car delivery.
The showroom is too big and they have display and test drive for all their cars. …
Had a truly wonderful car-buying experience at Sundaram Motors, Mercedes-Benz. From the very first interaction to the final delivery, everything was handled with utmost professionalism and care. …
My friend took delivery of her Mercedes-Benz E200 in Verde Silver today from Sundaram Motors, and the entire experience was excellent. …
